title: Ebema
description: ebema.be Ebema NV is a Belgian family-owned concrete products manufacturer founded in 1946 in Zutendaal, celebrating 80 years in 2026 under third-generation CEO Jan Bijnens. With around 250 employees, 3 production plants and annual revenue of roughly 65 million euro, it operates through three brands: Stone&Style for private gardens, LivingCity for public urban spaces and CustomConcrete for bespoke architectural concrete. The company leads Belgium's transition toward climate-adaptive cities with water-permeable paving, grass-joint tiles and circular low-carbon concrete made from recycled aggregates. Following its acquisition of Marlux assets in 2021, it strengthened its market position across Belgium, the Netherlands and neighboring countries. Key projects include sponge-city public squares and custom urban furniture across Brussels, Antwerp and Ghent. It combines industrial scale with sustainability initiatives including solar-powered plants and electric logistics.
